/service-areas/bakersfield-ca/.title: A little Bakersfield character. A lot of personality.
/service-areas/bakersfield-ca/.intro: From a museum wedding to a family celebration, our hometown gives a portrait theme plenty of personality. Tell us where you are celebrating and we will plan our robots around the space.

places.name: Kern County Museum
places.body: The museum offers wedding and event rentals among its historic settings. For a celebration here, we would explore a vintage-inspired portrait theme and a drawing station that leaves guest walkways clear.

places.name: CALM Zoo
places.body: CALM is a familiar Bakersfield family destination with community and seasonal events. A wildlife-inspired keepsake concept could suit a family gathering; any on-site activation would need the zoo’s approval.

places.name: The Willows at CALM
places.body: The Willows offers weddings within CALM. If it is on your venue shortlist, ask us about fitting a portrait experience into the reception timeline, subject to venue approval.

places.name: CASS Winery

places.name: Paso Robles Event Center & California Mid-State Fair

places.name: Firestone Walker Invitational Beer Festival
places.body: Firestone Walker lists its Invitational Beer Festival at the Paso Robles Event Center. For a brewery-hosted party or an organizer-approved activation, we could explore a simple craft-beer-inspired portrait theme and a pickup system that keeps the tasting experience moving.

places.name: Madonna Inn

places.name: Rod & Hammer Rock

/service-areas/visalia-ca/.title: From museum birthdays to big-room celebrations.

places.name: Visalia Convention Center
places.body: The city’s convention center provides a setting for larger events. For a proposed activation, we would review the floor plan, exhibitor requirements and portrait pickup location with your event team.

places.name: World Ag Expo

places.name: Tehachapi Mountain Festival
